import pandas as pd
SAVE,MARGIN,MONTHS,CALL,DISCOUNT=.5,.35,12,1500,.2
R=test.revenue_90/3
def pick(save):
    ex=test.p*save*MARGIN*MONTHS*R-CALL-DISCOUNT*R
    return test.assign(exp_profit=ex).loc[ex>0].sort_values(['exp_profit','client_id'],ascending=[False,True]).head(150).index
def value(idx,save):
    return float((test.loc[idx,'churn']*save*MARGIN*MONTHS*R.loc[idx]-CALL-DISCOUNT*R.loc[idx]).sum())
calls=pick(SAVE)
n_calls=len(calls)
caught=int(test.loc[calls,'churn'].sum())
profit_model=round(value(calls,SAVE))
profit_rule=round(value(test.sort_values(['revenue_trend','client_id']).head(150).index,SAVE))
profit_all=round(value(test.index,SAVE))
rows=[]
for save in [.3,.5,.7]:
    idx=pick(save)
    rows.append({'save':save,'fixed_profit':round(value(calls,save)),'reselected_n':len(idx),'reselected_profit':round(value(idx,save))})
sensitivity=pd.DataFrame(rows).set_index('save')
print(profit_model,n_calls,caught,profit_rule,profit_all,sensitivity)
